meta.title: Ultimate winter arc
meta.description: A 13-week morning field program for ultimate: throwing, cutting and conditioning, in Foundation, Build and Peak phases.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.line: Foundation: clean throwing mechanics, learning to stop and change direction well, and building the base for harder weeks.

phases.name: Build
phases.line: Build: throwing at game pace, sharper cutting patterns, and more power.

phases.name: Peak
phases.line: Peak: throwing and cutting under pressure and fatigue, with less volume so you stay sharp.

notes.1: Test week. Do Saturday's tests instead of conditioning, and keep the other sessions at the low end of each rep range.
notes.4: Lighter week. Cut every block's reps by about 40% and keep the quality high. You should finish feeling fresh.
notes.9: Lighter week. Cut every block's reps by about 40% before the Peak phase starts.
notes.13: Taper and retest. Halve the sets Monday to Friday, then do the tests on Saturday.

light.title: Light morning
light.intent: Team training is tonight, so this is volume, not a workout. No sprinting.

blocks.name: Target throws
blocks.dose: 25 backhands and 25 forehands to a cone at 15 to 20m
blocks.cue: Flat release, finish your follow-through toward the target.

blocks.name: Curves
blocks.dose: 5 each: inside-out backhand, outside-in backhand, inside-out forehand, outside-in forehand
blocks.cue: Pick a landing spot before each throw.

videos.label: Inside-out and outside-in
videos.search: ultimate frisbee inside out outside in throw

blocks.name: Overheads
blocks.dose: 10 hammers at 15m
blocks.cue: Relaxed arm, let the disc turn over.

blocks.name: Pivot throws
blocks.dose: 20 throws, stepping wide and releasing low
blocks.cue: Get your release below the mark's knees.

videos.label: Pivoting and low release
videos.search: ultimate frisbee pivot low release break throw

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.dose: 90/90 hip switches 2 × 8, couch stretch 60s per side, ankle rocks 15 per side, deep squat hold 60s
blocks.cue: Easy breathing. This keeps your hips and ankles ready for tonight.

videos.label: Ankle rocks
videos.search: knee to wall ankle mobility drill

cut-foundation.title: Cutting: stop and change direction
cut-foundation.intent: Stopping well matters more than raw speed. Every cut starts with a good stop.

blocks.name: Decel stops
blocks.dose: 6 reps: sprint 10m, stop in 2 to 3 steps, hold low for 2s
blocks.cue: Hips low before you plant. Walk back to rest.

blocks.name: 45° cuts
blocks.dose: 5 per side: jog 5m, plant the outside foot, accelerate 10m
blocks.cue: Short steps into the cut, eyes up.

blocks.name: 90° cuts
blocks.dose: 5 per side: sprint 10m, cut 90°, sprint 5m
blocks.cue: Chop your steps before the plant, don't slide.

videos.label: 90° cut
videos.search: 90 degree cut change of direction drill

blocks.name: Hip flips
blocks.dose: 4 per side: backpedal 5m, open your hips, sprint 10m
blocks.cue: Turn with your hips, not your shoulders.

blocks.name: Plyos
blocks.dose: Pogo hops 3 × 20, snap-downs 3 × 5, lateral line hops 3 × 10s
blocks.cue: Quiet, stiff ankles. Stop the set if contacts get sloppy.

blocks.name: Finish with throws
blocks.dose: 30 easy throws, then walk a lap
blocks.cue: Nothing hard. Just loosen up.

cut-build.title: Cutting: patterns and power
cut-build.intent: Put stops and starts together into the cuts you use in games, and add more power.

blocks.name: In-out cuts
blocks.dose: 6 per side: jab 2 steps deep, drive under 10m, plant, break out 10m
blocks.cue: Sell the first step with your shoulders.

videos.label: In and out cuts
videos.search: ultimate frisbee in cut out cut

blocks.name: Under-to-deep
blocks.dose: 6 reps: 2 steps under, sell it, turn and sprint 20m deep
blocks.cue: The fake only works if it looks like a real cut.

blocks.name: 5-10-5 agility
blocks.dose: 4 reps with 60 to 90s rest
blocks.cue: Time your best rep in Weeks 5 and 9.

blocks.name: Flying 20s
blocks.dose: 4 reps: 20m build-in, 20m at max speed, 2 minutes rest
blocks.cue: Relaxed face and shoulders at top speed.

blocks.name: Plyos
blocks.dose: Broad jumps 3 × 4, lateral bounds 3 × 5 per side (stick for 2s), single-leg hops 2 × 5 per leg
blocks.cue: Land quietly and stick every landing.

blocks.name: Catch on the cut
blocks.dose: 10 reps. Partner: leading passes on in-out cuts. Solo: throw a high, floaty pass and run it down
blocks.cue: Catch with two hands at full speed.

cut-peak.title: Cutting: reactive and under fatigue
cut-peak.intent: Cut on reaction instead of a script, and stay sharp when you're tired.

blocks.name: Reactive cuts
blocks.dose: 8 reps. Partner points or calls in, out, or deep at random. Solo: use a random-interval timer app for the cue
blocks.cue: React on the first cue. No guessing early.

blocks.name: Cut-cut-sprint
blocks.dose: 3 sets of 3: in-cut 10m, out-cut 10m, sprint deep 25m. 20s between reps, 2 minutes between sets
blocks.cue: Your last cut should look like your first.

blocks.name: Clear and re-cut
blocks.dose: 6 reps: sprint deep 20m, stop, re-cut under 10m
blocks.cue: Stop fast. This is how you get open for the second look.

blocks.name: Flying 20s
blocks.dose: 3 reps with full rest
blocks.cue: Stay sharp, not tired.

blocks.name: Plyos (reduced)
blocks.dose: Pogo hops 2 × 15, lateral bounds 2 × 4 per side
blocks.cue: Crisp and short.

short-foundation.title: Short game: mechanics
short-foundation.intent: Build a clean, repeatable release on both sides before adding pressure.

blocks.name: Target throws
blocks.dose: 20 backhands and 20 forehands from 20m at a 2m cone zone
blocks.cue: Count your hits. That's your baseline for this block.

blocks.name: Pivot series
blocks.dose: 10 low backhands and 10 low forehands breaking each way
blocks.cue: Step wide, stay balanced, keep your pivot foot planted.

videos.label: Pivoting and low release
videos.search: ultimate frisbee pivot low release break throw

blocks.name: Curves at 25m
blocks.dose: 2 rounds of 5 each: inside-out and outside-in, both sides
blocks.cue: Watch where each throw starts to turn.

videos.label: Inside-out and outside-in
videos.search: ultimate frisbee inside out outside in throw

blocks.name: Overheads
blocks.dose: 10 hammers or scoobers at 15m
blocks.cue: Hit a spot, not just the general area.

blocks.name: Quick release
blocks.dose: 20 throws: pick the disc off the ground and throw in one motion
blocks.cue: Grip ready before you stand up.

short-build.title: Short game: game pace
short-build.intent: Throw the way you will in games: faking, pivoting, and releasing fast.

blocks.name: Warm-up targets
blocks.dose: 20 throws from 20m at a 2m zone
blocks.cue: Log hits and compare with Weeks 1 to 4.

blocks.name: Fake-to-break
blocks.dose: 20 per side: fake one way, pivot, break the other
blocks.cue: Your fake should move your whole body, not just your arm.

videos.label: Faking and breaking the mark
videos.search: ultimate frisbee fake break the mark

blocks.name: 3-second release
blocks.dose: 30 throws: pick up the disc and pivot, count the stall out loud, release by 3
blocks.cue: Decide early. Hesitating is slower than a bad fake.

blocks.name: Two-cone breaks
blocks.dose: 20 throws alternating between cones on opposite sides
blocks.cue: Same release height every throw.

blocks.name: Low around breaks
blocks.dose: 20 throws
blocks.cue: Release outside and below where a mark's hand would be.

short-peak.title: Short game: pressure
short-peak.intent: Make your throws hold up when a miss costs you something.

blocks.name: 10 in a row
blocks.dose: Break throws from 20m at a 2m zone. Restart at 0 on any miss (cap at 15 minutes)
blocks.cue: Treat each throw like a stall of 8.

blocks.name: Accuracy ladder
blocks.dose: 5 throws each at 20m, 30m, and 40m. Hit 3 of 5 to move up. Do it on both sides
blocks.cue: If you stall on a distance, stay there.

blocks.name: Fatigue throws
blocks.dose: 8 rounds: sprint 20m, walk back, then immediately throw 2 breaks
blocks.cue: Settle your feet before you throw.

blocks.name: Live mark
blocks.dose: If you have a partner: 20 throws past an active mark
blocks.cue: Solo: repeat the 10-in-a-row block instead.

videos.label: Breaking the mark
videos.search: ultimate frisbee breaking the mark drill

long-foundation.title: Long game: controlled hucks
long-foundation.intent: Build a huck you can control before you chase distance.

blocks.name: Build distance
blocks.dose: 20 throws, stepping back 5m every 5 throws
blocks.cue: Same smooth motion at every distance.

blocks.name: Controlled hucks
blocks.dose: 10 backhands and 5 forehands at a 5m zone 35 to 40m away
blocks.cue: Focus on the angle and follow-through, not power.

blocks.name: Hammers to a zone
blocks.dose: 10 throws at 20m
blocks.cue: Pick a landing spot every time.

blocks.name: Wind work
blocks.dose: 10 upwind and 10 downwind throws
blocks.cue: Upwind: flatter and lower. Downwind: more angle, less power.

blocks.name: Resets
blocks.dose: 20 short throws to finish
blocks.cue: Easy and accurate.

blocks.name: Build distance
blocks.dose: 15 throws working back to 30m
blocks.cue: Don't rush into full hucks.

blocks.name: Hucks at 40m+
blocks.dose: 15 backhands and 10 forehands at a 5m zone
blocks.cue: Log hits. Aim to beat your Foundation-phase numbers.

blocks.name: Curved hucks
blocks.dose: 5 inside-out and 5 outside-in
blocks.cue: Let the curve bring the disc into the zone.

blocks.name: Step-out hucks
blocks.dose: 10 throws: pivot wide first, then huck
blocks.cue: Keep your balance through the step.

videos.label: Step-out huck
videos.search: ultimate frisbee huck pivot step out

blocks.name: Hammers over a mark
blocks.dose: 10 throws at 25 to 30m
blocks.cue: Get the release high enough to clear a raised hand.

long-peak.title: Long game: hucks under pressure
long-peak.intent: Throw long when you're tired, rushed, or throwing to a moving target.

blocks.name: Huck off the cut
blocks.dose: 8 reps: sprint 10m, pick up the disc, and huck within 3 seconds
blocks.cue: Set your feet fast, then throw.

blocks.name: Huck to a runner
blocks.dose: 10 throws. Partner runs deep. Solo: aim at a zone and move the cone after every throw
blocks.cue: Lead the receiver. Throw to space, not to a person.

blocks.name: Called distance
blocks.dose: 3 rounds of 3 hucks. Call 30m, 40m, or 50m before each throw
blocks.cue: Control beats max distance.

blocks.name: Overheads to a zone
blocks.dose: 10 hammers or blades
blocks.cue: Commit to the release.

cond-foundation.title: Conditioning: tempo
cond-foundation.intent: Build the aerobic base that lets you recover between points. Skip this on bootcamp weekends.

blocks.name: Tempo runs
blocks.dose: 10 to 12 × 100m at about 70%, walking back to recover
blocks.cue: Relaxed and steady. You should be able to talk after each rep.

blocks.name: Throws after
blocks.dose: 30 throws
blocks.cue: Get used to throwing with tired legs.

cond-build.title: Conditioning: repeat sprints
cond-build.intent: Build the ability to sprint hard over and over, like a long point. Skip this on bootcamp weekends.

blocks.name: Repeat sprints
blocks.dose: 3 sets of 6 × 40m with 20s rest between reps and 3 minutes between sets
blocks.cue: Your last rep should be within a second of your first.

blocks.name: Throws after
blocks.dose: 30 throws
blocks.cue: Break throws only.

cond-peak.title: Conditioning: game simulation
cond-peak.intent: Play points on your own: cutting, sprinting, and recovering like in a real game. Skip this on bootcamp weekends.

blocks.name: Game-sim points
blocks.dose: 8 points of about 45s (cut, cut, sprint deep, jog back, cut again) with 60 to 90s rest
blocks.cue: Every cut at game intensity.

blocks.name: Throws after
blocks.dose: 20 break throws
blocks.cue: Stay accurate while you're tired.

test.title: Test day
test.intent: Record your numbers so you can compare Week 1 and Week 13. Skip bootcamp this weekend if you can.

blocks.name: 30m sprint
blocks.dose: Best of 3 with full rest
blocks.cue: Time it on your phone from a standing start.

blocks.name: 5-10-5 agility
blocks.dose: Best of 3
blocks.cue: Touch each line with your hand.

blocks.name: Repeat sprints
blocks.dose: 6 × 40m with 20s rest
blocks.cue: Record your slowest rep.

blocks.name: Accuracy
blocks.dose: 10 backhands and 10 forehands from 20m at a 2m zone
blocks.cue: Record hits on each side.

blocks.name: Longest controlled huck
blocks.dose: Best of 5 that lands inside a 5m zone
blocks.cue: Pace out the distance and write it down.

reference.title: Rules for every morning
items: Train early while it's cool, and bring more water than you think you need.
Quality over volume. If your throws or cuts get sloppy, end the block there.
If Monday night left your legs flat, do Tuesday's session on Wednesday and throw only on Tuesday.
No bootcamp this weekend? Saturday's conditioning is on. Bootcamp weekend? Skip it; bootcamp is your conditioning.
Keep at least 6 hours and a proper meal between the morning session and gym at night.

reference.title: Test day (Saturday of Weeks 1 and 13)
reference.body: Warm up fully, then test in this order with full rest between. Write the numbers down so Week 13 can be compared fairly.
items: 30m sprint: best of 3, timed on a phone.
5-10-5 agility: best of 3, touch each line with your hand.
Repeat sprints: 6 × 40m with 20s rest. Record your slowest rep.
Accuracy: 10 backhands and 10 forehands from 20m at a 2m cone zone. Record hits.
Longest controlled huck: furthest throw that lands inside a 5m zone, best of 5.

reference.title: What you need
reference.body: At least 3 discs (5 or more is better for throwing blocks), 6 to 8 cones, a phone for timing, and a partner when you can get one. Every block has a solo version.
